title: Northern Growers' Key Farming Systems Insights 2023
reason: Provides key farming advice for Northern growers on managing nitrogen, weeds, and sowing dates.

tasks.task: Examine the key messages for Northern growers regarding profitability and risk management.

subtasks.text: Note that a range of farming systems have been profitable over the last five years.

frames.caption: The video frame shows a field with the text "1. Farming Systems" overlaid.
A bee is seen on a plant with green leaves and purple flowers.
A man in a checkered shirt is outdoors, gesturing with his hands.

subtasks.text: Highlight that legume systems are particularly profitable and help manage weeds and diseases.

frames.caption: A field of green plants with a background of greenhouses and industrial structures.
A legume field is shown with text overlay describing its profitability, lower risk, higher return on investment, and ability to help with weeds and diseases.

tasks.task: Discuss the importance of soil testing for nitrogen management.

subtasks.text: Emphasize the need to soil test before the coming season due to nitrogen losses from the previous years.

frames.caption: A person is inspecting a legume system, which is described as profitable, lower risk, higher ROI, and helps with weeds/disease.
A person is tending to a legume plant, with text overlay stating that legume systems are profitable, lower risk, and help with weeds/disease.

subtasks.text: Point out that the variation in soil nitrogen levels will likely be more extreme than in the last 20 years.

frames.caption: The video frame shows a close-up of a plant with text overlay about nitrogen costs and profitability.
The video frame shows a field of legume plants with text overlay discussing their profitability, lower risk, higher return on investment, and lower nitrogen input costs.

tasks.task: Address the challenges posed by the previous year's good harvest on weed management.

subtasks.text: Observe the increased weed seed set due to good years leading to large weed seed banks.

frames.caption: A man in a checkered shirt is standing outdoors with trees and a building in the background.
A man in a checkered shirt is standing outdoors with trees and a building in the background.

subtasks.text: Note the importance of pre-emergent herbicides to manage grass weeds, given the resistance to post-emergent herbicides.

frames.caption: A person is examining soil with the word "Nitrogen" overlaid.

tasks.task: Explain the importance of managing the Green Bridge to prevent disease spread.

subtasks.text: Describe the Green Bridge as cereals that establish during the summer months and should be destroyed before the next cropping cycle.

frames.caption: A person is using a tool to push sticks into the ground in a field.
A person is holding a soil test tool in a field.

subtasks.text: Explain why destroying the Green Bridge is crucial for preventing pathogen survival.

tasks.task: Stress the importance of sticking to sowing dates for optimal crop flowering.

subtasks.text: Mention that the disease pressure and logistics issues last year highlighted the importance of timely management.

subtasks.text: Remind growers to remain disciplined with sowing dates to achieve optimal flowering within the window.
